from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Case(BaseModel):
    """A single document representing a judicial case."""
    document_identifier: str = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    legal_domain: str | None = Field(description="Broad legal category such as 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal', or 'Execution'")
    dispute_topic: str | None = Field(description="The core legal dispute or subject matter (e.g., 'Demolition', 'Dereliction of Duty', 'Execution Objection')")
    procedural_stage: str | None = Field(description="The procedural nature of the case (e.g., 'First Instance', 'Second Instance', 'Retrial', 'Reconsideration')")
    parties: list[str] = Field(description="List of involved parties, e.g., plaintiff, defendant, applicant")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the court's decision or ruling")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[Case]
